disorder-name.detail: Patients with schizophrenia from the NUSDAST dataset; age range restricted to 22–37 years (same as HCP training set)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "we used the model to measure the quantity of deviation of the brain data from the NUSDAST and ABIDE data sets... NUSDAST data set, which composed of healthy controls and patients with SCZ"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Northwestern University Schizophrenia Data and Software Tool (NUSDAST); obtained via SchizoConnect virtual database
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The NUSDAST data set was obtained using the SchizoConnect (http://schizconnect.org/), a virtual database for public schizophrenia neuroimaging data."

age.detail: SCZ patients from NUSDAST; age range restricted to 22–37 years (same as HCP); values from Table 1

sex.detail: SCZ group from NUSDAST (n=35); percentages computed from counts (26/35=74.3%, 9/35=25.7%); paper reports 74% and 26% (rounded)

disorder-name.detail: Patients with autism spectrum disorder from the ABIDE-I dataset; age range restricted to 22–37 years (same as HCP training set); sample balanced for age and sex
disorder-name.supporting_text: "the ABIDE data set (http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide/abide_I.html), which composed of HC subjects and ASD patients balanced for age and sex"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I; URL in paper explicitly references abide_I; acquired from NITRC image repository
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The ABIDE data set was acquired from the Neuroimaging Informatics Tools and Resources Clearinghouse (NITRC) image repository (http://www.nitrc.org/)... ABIDE data set (http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide/abide_I.html)"

age.detail: ASD patients from ABIDE-I; age range restricted to 22–37 years (same as HCP); values from Table 1

sex.detail: ASD group from ABIDE-I (n=83); percentages computed from counts (74/83=89.2%, 9/83=10.8%); paper reports 89% and 11% (rounded)
